exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar/handles and feet planted.
Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep a slight arch in the upper back.
Lower the weight under control to mid-chest, elbows about 45° from the torso.
Press up and slightly back until the arms are straight, without losing the shoulder position.
mistakes: Flaring the elbows out to 90°, which stresses the shoulders.
Bouncing the weight off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar/handles and feet planted.
Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep a slight arch in the upper back.
Lower the weight under control to mid-chest, elbows about 45° from the torso.
Press up and slightly back until the arms are straight, without losing the shoulder position.
mistakes: Flaring the elbows out to 90°, which stresses the shoulders.
Bouncing the weight off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

mistakes: Flaring the elbows out to 90°, which stresses the shoulders.

Lifting the hips off the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30–45° and plant your feet.
Retract the shoulder blades and brace your core.
Lower the weight to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press up over the shoulders until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Using too steep a bench angle so it becomes a shoulder press.
Letting the shoulders roll forward at the top.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench.
Unrack with straight arms over the lower chest.
Lower to the lower chest under control.
Press back up, keeping the shoulder blades pinned.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift toward the neck.
Dropping the weight too fast.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Start with arms extended in front of the chest and a soft bend in the elbows.
Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep the elbow angle fixed throughout.
Squeeze the chest to bring the hands back together.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows, turning it into a press.
Going too heavy and overstretching the shoulders.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower until the chest is just above the floor, elbows about 45° from the body.
Push the floor away to return to the top.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike up.
Only doing half reps.
Flaring the elbows straight out.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight.
Lean the torso forward slightly to bias the chest.
Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders.
Swinging the legs for momentum.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip

Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows.

mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and the weight over your chest.
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly, then press back up.
mistakes: Bouncing the elbows off the floor.
Losing upper-back tightness.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and the weight over your chest.
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Floor Press

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Brace your core and keep a neutral spine.
Pull the weight toward your lower ribs, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower under control until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Jerking the torso to move the weight.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with hands just outside shoulder width.
Pull the shoulder blades down, then drive the elbows toward your ribs.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to a full hang under control.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging for momentum.
Stopping short of a full hang.
Craning the neck to get the chin over.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs locked under the pad and grab the bar.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to the upper chest.
Drive the elbows down and back, squeezing the lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Leaning far back and turning it into a row.

instructions: Stand facing the anchor with arms straight overhead holding the handle.
Hinge slightly forward and keep the arms straight.
Sweep the hands down to the thighs using your lats.
Return slowly to the stretched position.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so the triceps take over.
Using the torso to swing the weight.

exercises.name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set the anchor at face height and hold the rope with thumbs back.
Pull the rope toward your forehead, splitting the ends apart.
Finish with elbows high and hands beside the ears.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Pulling with the elbows dropped low.
Going so heavy you lean back.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull

mistakes: Pulling with the elbows dropped low.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall holding the weight at your sides or in front of the thighs.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles.
Bending the elbows to help.

exercises.name: 45° Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below the hip bones.
Lower the torso by hinging at the hips with a neutral spine.
Raise the torso until it is in line with the legs.
Avoid arching past neutral at the top.
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top.
Moving too fast and swinging.

exercises.name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Lift the arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for one to two seconds, squeezing the glutes and back.
Lower with control.
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top.
Moving too fast and swinging.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Start with the weight at shoulder height and your core braced.
Press straight up, moving the head slightly back so the path stays vertical.
Lock out overhead with biceps near the ears.
Lower under control back to the shoulders.
mistakes: Arching the lower back excessively.
Pressing the weight forward instead of overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with the weight at your sides and a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides, leading with the elbows.
Stop at shoulder height with the hands no higher than the elbows.
Lower slowly over two to three seconds.
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift the weight.
Shrugging the traps up during the raise.

Raise the arms out wide, leading with the back of the hands.
Squeeze the rear delts without shrugging.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades so the traps do the work.
Using momentum from the torso.

mistakes: Pulling above shoulder height, which can pinch the shoulder.

Letting the hips drop so it becomes a push-up.

Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift the weight.
Letting the elbows drift forward.
Cutting the bottom of the rep short.
